# Netsekurity.com

> You vibe code. We pentest. On-demand **Pentest as a Service (PTaaS)** — 1 credit = 1 pentest · 1 domain, verified with an auto-generated TXT record, delivered as a human-reviewed report. From $50.

Netsekurity (by Dalang Pte Ltd) secures apps built with AI ("vibe coding") and gives CI/CD pipelines continuous security: a pentest on every deploy, so results never go stale.

## What a pentest covers

An automated, unauthenticated, read-only vulnerability assessment of a verified domain's public surface: recon & subdomain discovery, tech/WAF fingerprint, security headers, TLS/PKI validation, exposed files & secrets, and common web-vuln probing (SQLi, XSS, open redirect, path traversal, misconfiguration). Findings are OWASP-mapped, CVSS v3.1 scored, and human-reviewed before the report is delivered.

## How it works

1. Create an account (Google sign-in).
2. Buy credits.
3. Add a domain.
4. Verify ownership with an auto-generated TXT record (`_netsekurity.<domain>`).
5. Run a pentest (dashboard button or CI/CD API token) — consumes 1 credit.
6. Download the human-reviewed PDF report.

## Continuous security (CI/CD)

Add a one-line step to your pipeline and scan on every deploy via an API token (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Jenkins / etc.). Catch regressions the day they ship instead of waiting for a yearly pentest.

## FAQ

- **How does pricing work?** 1 credit = 1 pentest on 1 domain. Buy a package, add a domain, verify with TXT, and a pentest is scheduled.
- **What is covered?** Public, unauthenticated, read-only OWASP-mapped scanning with human-reviewed findings.
- **How do I verify my domain?** We auto-generate a unique TXT record; add it to DNS and verify — no manual approval.
- **Is it automated?** The scan is automated end-to-end; a human security engineer reviews before the report is delivered.
- **I'm not technical / built this with AI — is this for me?** Yes. Plain-language report, no security background required.
- **Blackbox vs Whitebox?** This service is blackbox. Whitebox (source review + authenticated manual testing) is $10,000 USD per app/domain.
